failures.narrative: Worker landed in the shared main repo checkout instead of its isolated worktree. cd <main-repo-path> for the quality gate, then `git push` ran from there. With branch protection OFF, push to main succeeded.
failures.mitigation: Turned ON branch protection on main; hardened wave-2 worker prompts with explicit worktree guard

action_items.title: Worker dispatch prompt fails to keep worker pinned to its worktree — needs git -C <worktree-path> prefixes + branch-name guard before commit step
action_items.note: Already filed by the worker itself during the run; routing as SYSTEM gap since the fix lives in ~/Dev/ronan-skills/skills/{planner-worker,ralph}/SKILL.md, not in lekkertaal. Re-file or migrate the issue to ronan-skills.

action_items.title: Workers don't remove `in-progress` label after squash-merge — 4/5 wave workers left stale labels on closed issues
action_items.proof_ref: lekkertaal #139, #140, #155, #157 (all closed but kept `in-progress` until cleaned up post-merge)
action_items.note: The worker dispatch prompt adds `in-progress` on Step 2 but the cleanup is implicit (the issue auto-closes on squash-merge via `Closes #N` autoclose). The label survives the close. Add an explicit `gh issue edit <N> --remove-label in-progress` step right before or after the squash-merge in the worker prompt.

action_items.title: completion-report skill is spec-only — scripts/generate.sh missing from plugin cache
action_items.proof_ref: this run — /ro:completion-report was invoked, the skill SKILL.md loaded with references to scripts/{generate,risk-checks,diff-to-html}.sh but the scripts/ directory does not exist in the plugin cache; HTML was generated inline by the orchestrator
action_items.note: Either implement the scripts and ship them with the skill, or fold the HTML-generation logic INTO the SKILL.md itself as a heredoc-style bash block the orchestrator can copy-paste.
